description: This file contains unit tests for the KamonHistogram class, verifying its recording, retrieval, and reset functionalities using the JUnit testing framework.

classes.name: KamonHistogramTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying behavior of KamonHistogram, including recording values, ensuring retrieval does not reset the data, and reset functionality.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a new Histogram instance before each test, ensuring a clean state.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Tests recording a value in the histogram and subsequently verifies the recorded value.

methods.name: getRecordsDoesNotResetHistogram
methods.description: Ensures that calling getRecordedValues does not clear the histogram data.

methods.name: resets
methods.description: Verifies that reset clears the histogram's recorded values.
